svg.title: Sound Creations Ltd Company Profile 2026 - Page 13

text.tspan: Christ Is The Answer Ministries · Nairobi, Kenya
Worship services at CITAM Buruburu demanded clear, powerful and even sound
across a large, dynamic auditorium, including the under-balcony seating, serving
both live worship and broadcast. We delivered a full dB Technologies T-Series
system with dedicated subwoofers, under-balcony fills and stage monitors, run from
an Allen & Heath Avantis console. The result is a scalable system that brings clarity,
power and precision to every seat, live and on broadcast.
dB Technologies T12 and T8 front of house
